desc: Build an efficient smallest-prime-factor sieve up to \(10^6\).
Count distinct prime factors for every root \(x \le 10^6\), retaining \(x^2\) exactly when the count is two.
Sort the generated candidate squares and answer each query with `bisect_right`.
Validate correctness on the samples and edge cases, including \(A=36\), values just below/above candidates, and \(A=10^{12}\).
Ensure memory, runtime, input parsing, and batched output are suitable for \(Q \le 2\cdot10^5\).
